provider.name: Marine Regions
provider.organization_type: global marine geographic gazetteer, persistent-identifier, hierarchy, maritime-boundary, geospatial-download, OGC-service, and data-integration infrastructure
provider.description: Marine Regions is a global marine geographic information system maintained by the Flanders Marine Institute. It provides the Marine Regions Geographic Gazetteer, persistent MRGIDs, canonical and alternate names, feature types, hierarchical relations, coordinates, geometries, source citations, Exclusive Economic Zones and other maritime boundaries, IHO sea areas, downloads, REST and OGC web services, data schemas, release history, and interoperability with marine biodiversity, oceanographic, hydrographic, and legal data systems.
institutional_context: International hydrographic, oceanographic, biodiversity, fisheries, and law-of-the-sea communities
Marine biodiversity infrastructures including WoRMS and OBIS
National and international marine boundary, geographic-name, and geospatial-data authorities
